intro: Pico-Robertson centers on the busy crossroads of Pico and Robertson Boulevards just south of Beverly Hills, with LA's biggest cluster of kosher restaurants, bakeries and markets plus a few destination dining rooms.

to: Time Out: The best restaurants on the Westside
loc: Locale: The hottest new restaurants in LA

places.w: A small, friendly coffee and boba shop with house-made syrups.
places.o: A caramel latte or one of the seasonal specials.

places.w: A kosher bakery and cafe with excellent croissants, sourdough and beautifully plated breakfasts. Closed Saturdays.
places.o: The chocolate chip miso cookie and an egg breakfast.

places.w: A small pizza bar with an open kitchen, soft and airy crust, and creative toppings. Tables are hard to get.
places.o: The funghi or diavola, and save room for the tiramisu.

places.w: A lively kosher Mexican restaurant with inventive cocktails and mocktails.
places.o: Tacos, the taquitos and a margarita.
